reviews.title: Hidden Subscription Limitation – I Had to Pay Twice
reviews.text:
I purchased FOX One through my Roku TV, assuming I would be able to use the same subscription on both my Roku TV and my iPhone. Unfortunately, I later found out that the Roku subscription does not work in the FOX One iPhone app.

I spent about a week going back and forth with FOX One customer support, but they were unable to provide a solution. In the end, I had to purchase a second FOX One subscription using a different email address just to watch on my iPhone.

What disappointed me the most is that this limitation was never made clear before I subscribed. Had I known this in advance, I would have subscribed directly through FOX One instead of Roku.

From my perspective, this lack of transparency resulted in me paying twice for the same service—$20 for Roku and another $20 for the iPhone app.

My advice to other customers: If you plan to watch FOX One on multiple devices, especially on both Roku TV and an iPhone, subscribe directly through FOX One rather than through Roku. I wish someone had warned me before I made my purchase.

reviews.title: Disappointing broadcast of World Cup
reviews.text:
⭐️☆☆☆☆

Watching the World Cup on Fox One has been really frustrating. For a tournament this big, the coverage feels careless and underwhelming. Spoilers are hard to avoid, replays and basic viewing features have not been reliable, and the broadcast keeps killing the flow with commercials during hydration breaks instead of using that time for analysis, highlights, or actual soccer coverage. The commentary also feels noticeably less passionate than other World Cup broadcasts I’ve watched, which makes big moments feel flat instead of exciting. For something as special as the World Cup, the overall broadcast quality just has not been good enough.

reviews.text: Subscribed specifically to watch the World Cup games, but encountered multiple issues on one replay. First, the full game replay got to about 88 minutes of play when a huge popup covering 50% of the screen trying to auto play live TV. WHY WOULD I WANT THIS?! No matter what I tried, the pop up couldn’t be dismissed. After restarting and attempting to restart the replay, the app claims it’s not available. On top of all of this garbage, I’m forced to see ads for Fox News. -10/5, terrible experience.

reviews.title: One of the Worst Apps/World Cup Coverage
reviews.text: Only downloaded and paid for Fox One for the World Cup Coverage but it has been terrible. The app freezes and won’t load coverage regularly. The catch up through highlights is such an epic failure because it will show a goal scored then jump forward by 10 minutes and the score is 0-0 and there is no explanation of why. I just have accepted I can’t use that feature and have to watch the entire match to catch up. How many times will they come back from hydration breaks late. Can’t wait for the World Cup to be over to delete and cancel my account.

reviews.title: Glitchy, expensive, commercials
reviews.text:
Live sports streams often won’t play properly, they just dump you back in the main menu. For some reason starting a tv episode, then stopping and going back to the live sports stream usually works. 

As for TV shows, it only has the current or most recent seasons, so you can’t binge your favorite series. 

There’s no way to pay extra for commercial-free content, which might be because even with commercials it’s one of the most expensive TV streaming apps.

reviews.title: Bad UX design
reviews.text:
The user experience for the app is clearly not a polished one. The navigation logic of different sports and events are so counterintuitive, hard to find what I’m trying to look for. The personalized recommendations feels so bad. 

The worst glitch that’s making this app unusable is when I’m done watching any video/highlights the screen just completely turns dark, with no exit/return feature available on screen. I have to quit the app every time. Please hire someone better if you’re charging 20 dollars per month for your subscription.

reviews.title: Barely Works
reviews.text: App is great when it works, but it buffers and freezes constantly.  Trying to watch the World Cup games is a nightmare on this app.  It locks up and crashes at least 4 or 5 times per game, and goes into standard definition about half the time it is working.  Does it on several different wifi networks and on cellular data, so it's definitely an app issue.

reviews.title: NEVER AGAIN
reviews.text:
I’ve been watching the World Cup through FOX One, and it’s safe to say I won’t be using this app after this weekend. I’ll be finding another way to watch the tournament.

The experience has been frustrating from start to finish. The app crashes frequently, buffers at random times, and sometimes struggles to maintain a stable stream during live matches. What’s even more disappointing is how aggressively advertisements are pushed. Breaks seem longer than they need to be, and it often feels like coverage is being cut short just to squeeze in more commercials.

I’m clearly not the only viewer experiencing these issues. Many users have reported the same problems: crashes, freezing streams, playback errors, buffering, and constant interruptions. Some viewers have even complained about missing portions of live action because the broadcast stayed in commercials for too long.

This is the biggest sporting event in the world, and fans should be able to focus on the matches instead of wondering whether the app will crash again or if another ad break is coming. FOX One had a great opportunity to deliver a premium World Cup experience, but instead it feels like maximizing ad revenue has become a higher priority than providing a reliable viewing experience.

For a service responsible for broadcasting the World Cup, the performance is simply unacceptable. I expected better.

reviews.title: App works, but annoying recommedations
reviews.text:
Only got the app for the World Cup. It works and does its job. It wants to be too fancy with “my Stuff” and flashing scores on my phone. It all just gets in the way and is annoying.

Also, it is constantly showing me The Fox News shows as recommendations to remind me how bad their programming is. I can handle bad recommendations, I don’t need to see Fox News smug talking-heads every time I use the app. Can’t wait to cancel.

Was easier to delete it from my phone than to turn all their “features” off.

reviews.title: Less graphics, more actual information.
reviews.text: Got this for the World Cup. This app is great for accessing live, recorded/condensed, or highlights. It is absolutely maddening for getting basic information. Like scores of games in progress, or dates/times of upcoming matches. Also, this used to be on FoxSports and now I’m offered access to FoxNews “content”, which I am not interested in receiving. So beware.

Very disappointing app. I purchased a subscription specifically to watch the World Cup, but the streaming quality is terrible. The broadcast constantly freezes, buffers for 5–6 minutes at a time, and always seems to crash during the most important moments of the match. I even missed a goal because the stream was stuck loading.

For a paid service, this level of performance is unacceptable. Fans should be able to watch live sports without interruptions, especially during major events like the World Cup. I expected a reliable streaming experience, but instead I got constant buffering and missed key moments.

I would not recommend this app until the streaming issues are fixed.

reviews.title: Worse experience
reviews.text: Every live sport is worse when fox broadcasts it. The INDYCAR experience is riddled with ads and is frustrating to watch. NASCAR is much the same, with fans celebrating the switch to prime every season. I would rather watch the World Cup in Spanish on peacock than watch on fox. I would rather see a foreign company report on the news and broadcast sports instead of Fox. I can’t name one thing good about this company. Fox is a net negative on this country.

reviews.title: App does not work
reviews.text: I have been a paid Fox Nation member for about five years. I am supposed to be able to get the FOX One app and login using my Fox Nation user account information. However it does not work. I have spent many hours trying to make this work. I hope by Fox Nation will keep working. Otherwise, I won’t pay for it anymore. I don’t think I will ever be able to get Fox one. The app just keeps wanting me to sign up for a new account with a seven day trial. I don’t want to pay for two Fox accounts.

reviews.title: App is unusable because of sign-in issues
reviews.text:
EDIT:  This is still happening but not as often. Fox says they want me to contact their support. But look, I’m not alpha or beta testing apps for companies anymore. They need to do their own testing and quality control. I can live without this app and service.

About every other day, this app signs me out of my TV provider, and re-sign-in fails repeatedly until I delete the app, reboot my phone, and re-download the app.  Deleting and reinstalling without rebooting doesn’t work, have to reboot in between.

reviews.title: Love Fox hate this App!
reviews.text:
I have no issues with any other apps but this one; It constantly has issues.  

It’s cheap at 20 to watch Fox Business which is cheap vs another subscription; but every week, frequently more than once, I have to reinstall.  I cannot figure out why Fox can’t get it together with this app.  I am shocked that on App Store it gets high marks because on other sites like on Samsung where it’s rated it only gets three stars. For me, on a scale of 1-10 with 1 being worst imaginable it gets a 1.  Also, frequently audio is not in sync with the feed, and other rookie issues, beyond access, but it’s the constant reinstalling that is tiring…I will keep this garbage app so I can watch Fox Business at the cheap price, or it would be so gone!

reviews.title: Frustrated customer
reviews.text: After months of trying to like this app I finally just throw in the towel and canceled my subscription. This is hands-down the worst app I have ever tried to use. It freezes up my TV to the point to where I have to unplug my TV and reset it every single time I try to watch this. But before anybody says it’s my TV this is the only app that does this to my television. I can watch it on my phone just fine but I have to have my phone for work..

reviews.title: The buggiest streaming app on the market
reviews.text: Purchased the plan throng apple but used the app on Samsung TV. How many times can the viewing experience, crash, restart the content and force you to watch another ad and turn on the CC automatically in the progress? Half a dozen times at least in 10-15 minutes. Developers must have built the service in while abusing substances or perhaps finance clearly give them budget required to build it properly. The UI is terrible too (CC looks terrible, search bar is poorly laid out, scrubbing controls are glitchy, etc.)

reviews.title: Don’t these people understand how sports work?
reviews.text: If you include a button that gives you the option to “watch from beginning” (as opposed to “join live”) that also means you are going to finish AFTER the game ends. So the fact that you just get booted from the stream right in the middle of the 9th inning when the live stream ends is absolutely insane. Please think about how people will actually use your product.

reviews.title: Terrible channel selection
reviews.text: Using the Fox One subscription to watch the World Baseball Classic has thus far been a terrible experience. The interface shows “live” games that have not het started. If you use the “catch up with highlights” function, you will be disappointed—it is clearly “AI” because it doesn’t actually show any of the plays…just guys going into the dugout well after the important play is over. Add in the fact that you are bombarded with Fox News ads and it completes the terrible experience.

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: I would not even give it one star if I did not have to. I absolutely will not renew my FOX One subscription. I wish I could just get my money back. Can’t watch some shows that I thought I would be able to. A month after I purchased, I was unable to watch one of the few shows that I wanted to watch that I had been watching. A couple of days later, it magically started working again. The online chat help is of no use. It started doing the same thing the other day. I go to watch my show and it takes me to a screen where it wants me to bundle with FOX nation. Cannot get past that screen. Again, online chat was no help.  There is no way I’m going to bundle and pay more money.  Absolutely ridiculous that I cannot contact and have somebody on the technical end to fix this issue.

reviews.title: Insane Sign on Issues
reviews.text:
I’ve just about had it with Fox One. I’ve activated Fox One about 30 times and after I activate I get the following message:  “You're signed in. Your TV will refresh
momentarily.”  Of course, I’m not actually signed in, just a viscous loop. 

Sometimes when I try to log on it doesn’t give me the QR to scan. At this point my only recourse is to delete the app and try again. These problems I’m referring to are on my television, but as I see it, it’s all interconnected. I’ve had the Fox One app working on my television, but the next time I turn on the television it’s this whole aggravating activation process again.

reviews.title: My stuff disappears
reviews.text: The app plays, but it constantly will delete the things that I have put a + on in my stuff. I will have shows in my stuff and then after a while they just disappear and then I have to go back and check it again and put it in my stuff. I have lost several shows I want to watch because it constantly does this.

reviews.title: Very poor live agent support.   You can’t watch NFL full games.
reviews.text: What a very disappointing experience. Free trial so I could watch the NFL games found out. You can’t watch them, tried to cancel free trail subscription, and when you finally get to a live agent on the chat because they don’t have the Cancel the manage the subscription options. The agent asked you to verify the credit card number and then Just disappears.   No easy way to get back to the chat you were on.

reviews.title: Just Awful!
reviews.text: Just awful! Need to reboot Firestick to use it after turning TV off. Recorded programs randomly take from an hour to a day to show up anywhere (not just My Stuff). Random programs only play audio (no video). Randomly, some programs never show up after recording. With such a small number of programs, you’d think they would do better. Only reason I use it is for the content. With Fox’s money, they should have a 1st class product by now.

reviews.title: Free Trial is a Scam
reviews.text:
I signed up for a 7-day free trial of FOX One, canceled the subscription through Apple well before the trial ended, and still got charged twice. I provided screenshots of my credit card statement showing the charges, yet FOX One insisted the last four digits of my card “don’t match their system” and refused to issue a refund.

Their support team keeps repeating the same question instead of actually investigating the issue or escalating it. I canceled months ago, haven’t used the service, and still ended up paying for it—with no resolution. Easily one of the most frustrating customer service experiences I’ve ever had. I would strongly discourage anyone from using this app unless you’re okay with being charged even after you cancel.

reviews.title: Not worth paying for
reviews.text: I catch updates after they’re over and then have to deal with the onslaught of commercials that I do not watch regular TV for. If you’re going to charge for your service, at least be kind enough to reduce the amount of commercials or stop them entirely when they are played back shows. I am very disappointed and will cancel this and FOX nation as neither one of them seem to be worth the cost.

reviews.title: Subscription Through TV Provider Doesnt Work
reviews.text: I’ve had a paid subscription through my TV provider (Spectrum) for over a month that I can’t access. Customer support keeps sending me login instructions but the problem is with the link to my TV provider subscription. When I log in I’m able to see my account is linked to Spectrum. Very frustrating that I can’t get a resolution through customer service.

reviews.title: Trash Misleading
reviews.text: Completely misleading app I paid for this app to watch the baseball games live but I was able to save each game and rewatch it with my family later, then came game seven and also watched live and then saved the game to rewatch it later again just to find it’s now unavailable and I can only rewatch game five which I already did. My Mom is completely disappointed with this, I paid $20 for this just to get nothing in the long run, you can do better than this Fox. I legitimately feel scammed by this app.
